citations.quote: Classic recommenders still handle bulk, reliable ranking at scale, while LLMs are applied where cold start, long-tail intent and semantic understanding matter most.
Consumers only see stores that are geographically close to them, so the consumer-store matrix is too sparse for naive collaborative filtering.
Using Store2Vec embeddings in our personalized emails improved click-through rate by 5%.
A two-tower embedding model learns customer and item representations from sparse order histories, engagement sequences and context features.
The system particularly benefits consumers with sparse engagement histories or new users.
The UserContext service cut feature lag from more than 24 hours with batch pipelines to a few seconds.
The graph-learned embeddings gave a 12% AUC lift over the baseline ranking model.
A contextual bandit dynamically allocates retrieval slots across candidate sources under a fixed compute budget.
Rule-based filtering for allergies and seasonality achieved 100% precision in technical validation.
Contextual-bandit algorithms address the cold-start problem by exploring with non-personalized, popular items before adapting to the user.
Delivery Hero saw an 85% jump in conversions from personalized onboarding and communication.
Personalized push notifications sent before mealtimes lifted orders by 28% compared with generic messages.
Deep Brew is credited with an estimated $2.1 billion in incremental revenue from AI-driven personalized recommendations between 2023 and 2024, with same-store sales up 4-6% in channels using it.
Personalization can reduce acquisition costs by as much as 50 percent, lift revenues by 5 to 15 percent, and increase the efficiency of marketing spend by 10 to 30 percent.
Win-back campaigns lifted reactivation to 14% and cut re-acquisition CAC by about 22% versus new-user spend.
Domino's revenue grew 63% as mobile conversions tripled and cost per conversion was halved.
DashPass sign-ups from March 2023 had 69% retention after one month, 36% after six months, and 28% after twelve months.
Purchase-based targeting strategies drove 4x the sales uplift of other strategies while using 50% fewer impressions.
Advertising and other revenue topped $1 billion for full-year 2025, and first-quarter advertising revenue reached $286 million, up 16% year over year.
Uber's advertising business has passed a $2B annualized run rate, growing more than 50% year over year.
As of October 2024, 9% of US online grocery shoppers had Instacart+, compared with 25% for Walmart+ and 11% for DashPass.
For grocers, personalization at scale can drive a sales lift of 1-2% of total sales, along with a 10 to 20 percent reduction in marketing and sales costs.
DoorDash has built advertising into one of its fastest-growing revenue lines, selling sponsored listings to restaurants and CPG brands alike.
Once food data reveals allergies, weight or a medical condition, explicit consent under Article 9(2)(a) becomes the practical legal basis.
Most consumer nutrition and food delivery apps are not covered entities under HIPAA, so its protections do not apply.
In its first-ever enforcement action under the Health Breach Notification Rule, announced February 1, 2023, the FTC ordered GoodRx to pay a $1.5 million civil penalty.
On March 4, 2022 the FTC's settlement required WW International and Kurbo to delete illegally collected data from children, destroy any algorithms derived from it, and pay a $1.5 million penalty.

The 2026 Cal AI breach exposed meal logs, weight and profile data of 3.5 million users through an unauthenticated Firebase database; MyFitnessPal itself suffered a 2018 breach affecting 150 million accounts.
Instacart receives a privacy score of 22/100 in our 2026 audit.
We checked 50 restaurants on DoorDash and UberEats: 80% had zero allergy safety features.
The EU AI Act, which entered into force in August 2024, treats AI that profiles people on health or behaviour as high-risk.
GDPR and HIPAA are foundational but often inadequate for the complexity of modern AI-driven nutrition pipelines.
72% of the personalized nutrition systems studied were not compliant with GDPR.
